requirements.requirement: Introduce a phone, tablet, and desktop adaptive Framework7 shell without breaking deep links.
requirements.rationale: The target remains valuable but depends on the Phase 1 compatibility seams and Phase 2 design foundation.

requirements.requirement: Replace direct icon-library usage with a semantic Phosphor registry.
requirements.rationale: Phase 0F inventories every icon callsite and retains the migration as a controlled target.

requirements.requirement: Keep private application data local-first and account scoped.
requirements.rationale: Local-first remains the target, with explicit purge, migration, quota, and corruption contracts added.

requirements.requirement: Combine lexical and semantic retrieval rather than using semantic-only search.
requirements.rationale: The staged retrieval roadmap preserves deterministic lexical fallback and later semantic fusion.

requirements.requirement: Provide evidence-linked Gist synthesis for Explore and Search.
requirements.rationale: Synthesis must be grounded, explainable, locally private by default, and safe when models are unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Offer contextual composer assistance.
requirements.rationale: It depends on safe entity, conversation, retrieval, and privacy foundations.

requirements.requirement: Prototype an AI-assisted interpolator.
requirements.rationale: No runtime AI authority is introduced during Phase 0; the feature remains behind later evaluation and privacy gates.

requirements.source: Mangane and inherited Soapbox operational behavior
requirements.requirement: Preserve Akkoma, Pleroma, and Mastodon-compatible behavior.
requirements.rationale: Compatibility becomes an explicit capability contract instead of presentation-layer assumptions.

requirements.requirement: Retain multi-account login and switching.
requirements.rationale: The behavior is preserved with account-generation fencing, deterministic purge, and future immutable scope contracts.

requirements.requirement: Remain installable and useful during degraded connectivity.
requirements.rationale: Offline behavior is retained while authenticated-response caching and worker ownership become explicit.

requirements.requirement: Preserve native push notifications and notification actions.
requirements.rationale: Actions remain supported with restart-durable revocation and a queued destination-policy migration.

requirements.requirement: Accept operating-system share-target text into the composer.
requirements.rationale: The feature is preserved with exact same-origin routing, bounded input, content-type validation, and inert redirect construction.

requirements.requirement: Allow instance-specific name, theme, and branding.
requirements.rationale: Custom branding remains supported but must flow through governed tokens and safe configuration boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Render administrator-provided pages and descriptions.
requirements.rationale: Administrator authority does not make remote markup trusted; central sanitization and URL policy are mandatory.

requirements.requirement: Report production errors to a remote telemetry provider.
requirements.rationale: Remote telemetry is removed and remains prohibited without explicit consent, redaction, retention, deletion, and opt-out controls.

requirements.requirement: Publish production source maps for diagnostics.
requirements.rationale: Production source maps are prohibited because no protected artifact channel or redaction boundary exists.

requirements.requirement: Install artifacts from Soapbox GitLab and Soapbox-specific filesystem paths.
requirements.rationale: The commands target a different upstream, branch, artifact, and deployment layout and are unsafe as current Mangane instructions.

requirements.requirement: Clone and develop from the Soapbox GitLab repository.
requirements.rationale: Repository identity and toolchain commands must point to the current Mangane repository and verified package scripts.

requirements.source: inherited UI behavior and modernization requirements
requirements.requirement: Preserve keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, live-region, localization, and non-gesture alternatives.
requirements.rationale: Phase 0F and Phase 0G establish executable baselines that later UI migration cannot silently remove.

requirements.requirement: Retain build and test artifacts for debugging.
requirements.rationale: Artifacts are disabled by default and require declared purpose, redaction, access control, and retention before enablement.

requirements.requirement: Retain TaffyDB-backed behavior.
requirements.rationale: License and maintenance concerns require replacement analysis before removal; transitive presence is not treated as safe.

requirements.requirement: Establish a clean production TypeScript graph.
requirements.rationale: Phase 0G pins 101 inherited diagnostics exactly and prohibits new debt; elimination belongs to the Phase 1 authority migration.
